subject: tables: force to lock the touched index in DML when DDL merging temp index (#62387)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for session/table changes: table index DML writes/deletes mark normal index keys with SetNeedLocked during BackfillState{ReadyToMerge,Merging}, and session.KeyNeedToLock now locks non-unique index keys only when that flag is present (preserving prior default of skipping non-unique index locks). Checked the pessimistic DML lock collection path (LazyTxn.KeysNeedToLock in pkg/session/txn.go) and later upstream history; no remaining Blocker/High correctness/consistency issues found.
